user.title: Add a Google Home by IP
user.description: Enter the local IP address of the Google Home. Home Assistant connects to it directly on port 8009, without mDNS discovery.

data_description.host: Local IP of the device, for example 192.168.0.9. Reserve it in your router so it does not change.
data_description.name: Name of the device and its media player entity.

error.cannot_connect: The device does not respond on port 8009. Check the IP and that Home Assistant can reach it on the network.

abort.already_configured: A Google Home with this IP is already configured.

init.title: Options for {name}
init.description: Change the IP if the Google Home got a new address. Set the Home Assistant URL if the speaker cannot reach the internal URL (for example, Home Assistant runs on another network): it is used for local files and TTS. The integration reloads if the IP changes.

data.base_url: Home Assistant URL for the speaker

data_description.base_url: Optional. Base URL the Google Home uses to download local audio and TTS, e.g. {example_url}. Leave empty to use the internal URL.

error.cannot_connect: The device does not respond on port 8009. Check the IP and that Home Assistant can reach it on the network.
error.already_configured: Another Google Home is already configured with this IP.

play_audio.name: Play audio
play_audio.description: Plays an audio file or stream on the Google Home, with optional volume and volume restore.

media.name: Audio
media.description: URL (http/https), media-source:// ID, or local path inside /config/www (for example /config/www/sounds/bell.mp3 or /local/sounds/bell.mp3).

restore_volume.name: Restore volume
restore_volume.description: Return to the previous volume when the audio finishes.

announce.name: Announcement
announce.description: Interrupts what is playing and resumes it when the audio finishes (radio, files and TTS played on the default receiver; apps such as Spotify cannot be resumed).

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Plays an optional chime, then a spoken message or audio, and resumes what was playing when it finishes.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to read aloud (TTS). Use this or 'media'.

media.name: Audio
media.description: URL, media-source:// or local path, instead of a spoken message.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Announcement volume (0-1). If omitted, the automatic day/night volume is used.

tts_entity.name: TTS entity
tts_entity.description: Voice engine to use. If omitted, the default one.

fade_in.name: Fade in
fade_in.description: Seconds to raise the volume from zero.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Resume the audio that was playing when the announcement ends.

fade_volume.name: Fade volume
fade_volume.description: Moves the volume to a value over a period of time. Stops if you change the volume manually.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to reach the target volume.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Turns the speaker off after some minutes, fading the volume down first. Use 0 minutes to cancel.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes until turning off. 0 to cancel.

fade_out.name: Fade out
fade_out.description: Seconds of volume fade before turning off.

path_not_allowed.message: The path {path} is outside {www}. Only files inside /config/www can be played.

no_url.message: Unable to determine the Home Assistant URL. Configure the local network URL in Settings > System > Network or the Home Assistant URL in the integration options.

announce_empty.message: Provide a message or an audio for the announcement.

no_tts.message: No text-to-speech (TTS) engine is available. Install one or set 'tts_entity'.
